content.about: Senegal is the westernmost country of mainland Africa. Dakar, its capital, sits on a peninsula. It is known for music, wrestling and teranga, meaning hospitality. Gorée Island is a memorial to the slave trade.

standout.text: Lake Retba, or Lac Rose, turns pink because of salt-loving algae.

didYouKnow: The African Renaissance Monument is taller than the Statue of Liberty.
